thread:
eve (Design): Quick check  the new default smoothing hides 10-20s spikes in dashboard panels. customers flagged missed alerts.

noel (PM): We can't break incident visibility. Can we add a "preserve quick spikes" switch on each panel rather than changing global behavior?

jordan (Viz Eng): Yep. Built a tiny alt: 'preserve_quick_spikes' using MAD-based threshold and a small marker. Config: `preserve_quick_spikes: true \nmad_factor: 2.8 \nmax_markers: 6`

samir (A11y): Accessibility: markers need accessible names, focusability, and not rely on color. use shapes+patterns for colorblind. ensure contrast on dark theme.

eve (Design): Copy suggestion for toggle: "Keep short spikes". Legend microcopy should show "preserve:on" when active, collapsed behind chevron.

noel (PM): Also: thresholds should be metric-aware (percent vs absolute). suggest an 'auto' option. For A/B we can enable preserve in 50% of staging panels.

jordan (Viz Eng): Impl note: cap markers to avoid perf issues, and add debug overlay to show raw preserved indices for QA.

samir (A11y): Add keyboard shortcut 'P' to toggle preserve for focused chart, with tooltip and visible focus ring. aria-describedby should include current smoothing state.

design-ci: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/preserve_short_spikes_v1.png

eve (Design): I'll update the spec and file a PR with QA checklist: keyboard nav, aria labels, color contrast, legend truncation, metric-adaptive thresholds.
